ad_note_scope: Scope: "Agent only" counts the agent direct members; "Agent line" counts the agent plus every downline agent members.
ad_note_people: Member counts: each member is counted once per query; the agent-line mode de-duplicates across agents.
ad_note_money: Amounts: only successful, valid transactions are counted; non-main currencies are converted to the site main currency at the rate of that settlement (converted and stored at settlement time). Queries only aggregate and never re-convert at query time, so a historical report always returns the same numbers.
ad_note_retention: Retention: the date range defines the registration cohort, then the cohort behavior is checked on D1 / D7 / D30. For all other metrics the date range refers to the day the behavior happened. Immature cohorts are still counted, as not retained.
ad_note_timezone: Timezone: date ranges and day boundaries always follow the selected timezone shown in the header, using one consistent rule.
ad_note_detail: Detail (phase 2): one row is one member aggregated over the period, listed once; time columns always show the FIRST occurrence, never the last. Retention detail shows the first behavior on that D day, or "—" if the member did not return. The agent breakdown is a period aggregate and therefore has no time column.
ad_detail_note: One row is one member aggregated over the period, listed once; time columns show the FIRST occurrence, or "—" if it never happened.
